text: Raises one SubGenius Group's Power to 6 and stays linked to it; counts as that Group's action. At any time. One per player in play.

name: Advanced Supersonic Aluminum Nazi Hell Creatures from Beneath the Hollow Earth
text: When they take part in a successful Attack to Destroy a rival's Group, you may draw a Plot.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Anti-Slack
text: At any time, on a rival whose Illuminati holds two or more tokens: remove one. No player can be hit by more than one Anti-Slack per turn.

name: Arise!
text: Goal: when a rival removes your last puppet, show this card: you stay in until the end of the turn, and if you still have no puppets then, you win. This victory may be shared, even with a player of the same Illuminati.

name: Attitude Mutation
text: At any time: add, remove or reverse one alignment of a Group you control until the end of the turn. Free for a Group your Illuminati controls directly; otherwise it costs its master's action. One per turn.

name: "Bobbies"
text: When you take them over you may hang them on any rival's open arrow. They never count toward a Goal and raise their owner's Basic Goal by one Group. A successful attack on them makes the attacker discard them or give them to a rival; nothing else moves them except losing their master.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Brag of the SubGenius
text: Goal: each SubGenius Group of Power 3 or more you control counts as two Groups for the Basic Goal.

name: Bulldada
text: Right after any die roll: that roll becomes a 12. Costs three other Plot discards.

name: Cast Out False Prophets!
text: Goal: eliminate a player with the same Illuminati as yours by removing their last Group. Or play it as a Plot: +10 to an Attack to Destroy on the False Prophets, one of their puppets, or their master unless that master is an Illuminati.

name: Church of Middle America
text: A SubGenius Group controlling it gets +2 Power (and +2 Global Power if it has any).
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Church of the SubGenius
text: Power 7/7. Keeps its Action tokens from turn to turn (Slack) and spends one per action. It and your SubGenius Groups get +2 on direct Attacks to Control SubGenius Groups. Special Goal: up to 3 Slack (tokens on this card) count as Groups toward the Basic Goal; this cannot be combined with any other Goal.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Citizens for Normalcy
text: The Church of the SubGenius, the Discordian Society and Weird or SubGenius Groups cannot attack it directly to control, take it over automatically or have it moved under them. Spend its token and an Illuminati token: cancel any Plot.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Comet Hail-Bob
text: Right after a rival takes control of a Group from hand or the uncontrolled area (automatic takeover, attack or card): that Group is destroyed, not counting for any Goal. Costs an Illuminati action or two Church actions. Once per game per player.
playRequirement: Requires an Illuminati action, or actions from two Church groups

name: Connie Dobbs
text: While she is both Straight and SubGenius, neither she nor any Group she controls can be destroyed (no Attack to Destroy may be made on them).
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Corrective Phrenologists
text: When they attack or defend in an attack involving a rival's Violent Group, they get a fresh Action token as soon as the dice are rolled.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Dallas Catacombs
text: Your Groups may hang on any side of their master and switch sides at any time, arrows or not, but no master may have more puppets than outgoing arrows. If you lose the Catacombs, move everything back onto real arrows (free); what does not fit is discarded.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Decency is OK!
text: Cancel an action taken or aided by a rival's Weird Group.

name: Devival
text: +10 Power or Resistance to a SubGenius Group you control. With an action: played when it is declared, for that action only. On defense: until the end of the turn, not for Goals. One per action or defense.

name: Divine Mail Order
text: Its action: draw a Plot. Its action plus an Illuminati action: draw three Plots.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Dobbstown
text: +5 on any attempt to control a SubGenius Personality.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Dokstok
text: Its controller gets one extra token at token placement, which must first go to another player's Illuminati (as a gift or trade) or be thrown away.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Dr. K'Taden Legume
text: While he is yours and SubGenius, no attack of any kind may be made on your other SubGenius Personalities.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Drs. for "Bob"
text: May add their Power to the defense of any SubGenius Group you control as a free move, without a token.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Eternal Salvation or Triple your Money Back
text: With a SubGenius action, at any time: draw Plots until you hold five. Once per game.

name: Excremeditation
text: Illuminati action, at any time: an Action token for one SubGenius Group, or for several with 5 total Power or less. Not for Groups holding a token or barred from tokens.

name: Fake Healing
text: On your turn: one Group in the uncontrolled area (or your hand) has Resistance 0 until the end of the turn.

name: False Overman
text: Outside an attack, link to any Personality in play, controlled or not, that is not an OverMan: Power 3, Violent and Straight, never Peaceful or Weird.

name: False Prophets
text: +4 on any attempt to control or destroy a rival's Church Group.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: False Slack
text: Illuminati action, at any time: remove every token from one rival Group (not an Illuminati) and from all Groups below it. One per victim per turn.

name: 'Frop Farm
text: Its action: remove every Action token from one Personality.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Give Me Slack, Or Give Me Food
text: Right after you play a Plot: instead of letting it resolve, discard this and one more card and take that Plot back into your hand.

name: Glorps
text: Double Power when attacking or aiding an Attack to Destroy a SubGenius Group; triple if their controller has exposed The Anti"Bob".
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Good Sex for Mutants Dating League
text: Every rival of its controller gets -2 on any attempt to control a Weird Group.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Head Launching
text: At any time: a Group's Global Power becomes equal to its permanent Power; linked to it. Costs that Group's action and two other Plot discards.
playRequirement: Needs an action from the group affected, plus discarding two other Plot cards.

name: Inherently Bogus
text: Outside an attack: a Church of the SubGenius Illuminati with no SubGenius Groups in its Power Structure loses one token. One per victim per turn.

name: Janor Device
text: Unique. Its holder may change any die roll he makes by 1 up or down. A natural 11 or 12 rolled by the holder ends their turn if it is his, and the Device goes to a rival: every rival rolls two dice and the highest takes it.
uniqueness: Unique Gadget

name: Jesus B.
text: Once per game while he is yours, buy one Slack by mailing a real dollar to the SubGenius Foundation.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: JHVH-1
text: Illuminati action, at any time: a rival discards half their Plots (round up), their choice.
playRequirement: Needs an action from your Illuminati.

name: Kill "Bob"!
text: During an Attack to Destroy a SubGenius Group: after the dice, if the attack succeeded, every player on the attacking side gets an Illuminati token. If the target was yours, you get one either way. Once per turn.

name: League for Obvious Decency
text: Its action: put up to two exposed Plots on top of the shared Plot deck (in standard play, their owner's deck).
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Local Clenches
text: Get an extra Action token each turn while they are SubGenius.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Luck Plane
text: Right after any die roll: that roll becomes a 2. An attack of strength below 2 still fails without a roll. Costs three other Plot discards.
playRequirement: Needs discarding three other Plot cards.

name: Martyr Meter
text: Unique. At its holder's token placement, one of his Personalities (his choice) gets an extra Action token.
uniqueness: Unique Gadget

name: Mediocretinism
text: At any time: a Group loses SubGenius until the end of the turn.

name: Miraculous Manifestation
text: At any time: every player draws a Group into the uncontrolled area. In standard play each draws a Group into hand and shows it to you.

name: More Slack
text: At any time, pay one Slack: expose all your own Plots. Once per game per player.

name: MWOWM
text: When anyone discards a Plot, spend its action and roll a die: on 3 or less you take that Plot.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Nental Ife
text: Link to a SubGenius Personality at any time: its Global Power equals its printed Power. Costs that Personality's action.

name: NHGH
text: Cannot be destroyed. Only a player who exposed The Anti"Bob" may control it. While uncontrolled, its Power of 5 is added to every Attack to Destroy. In standard play it may be played as a Plot for +5 to one Attack to Destroy on a rival, who then takes it into hand.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Official, all Inclusive, Divine Excuse
text: When a Personality is attacked, before the roll: the attack fails.

name: . . . Or Kill Me!
text: When your Illuminati has no Slack, pick a rival who has some: they give your Illuminati one token or discard a Group from their Power Structure. For the rest of the turn you may only defend.

name: OverMan
text: Outside an attack, link to any Personality in play, controlled or not, that is not a False OverMan: Power and Global Power 3.

name: OverMan Philo Drummond
text: Every Weird Group he controls is SubGenius. OverMan and False OverMan cannot affect him.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Phlegm Elementals
text: When they take part in an attack, the target is marked once the dice are rolled: it skips its next token placement.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Pinks
text: Whenever they have no token they may take one from another Straight Group you control.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Psychic Pstench
text: With a SubGenius Personality's action, at any time: a rival shows all their Plots, or discards one exposed Goal.

name: Rain of Prairie Squid
text: Outside an attack: shuffle the whole uncontrolled area into the Group deck and deal the same number of new cards there. In standard play, discard any Groups from your hand and draw as many.

name: Random Jesii
text: Outside an attack, with a SubGenius or Church action: a rival exposes all but one of their Plots. Not against the Martyr Meter's holder.
playRequirement: Needs the action of a SubGenius or Church group.

name: Rant!
text: On your turn after token placement, spend the action of a Personality with an open outgoing arrow: take a Group or Resource from the uncontrolled area (your hand in standard play) into play without a roll; a Group goes under that Personality. Your turn then ends.
playRequirement: Needs the action of a Personality that has a free outgoing control arrow; your turn then ends

name: Repent!
text: Right after your token placement: your turn ends at once and your Illuminati gets one more token.

name: Reverend Ivan Stang
text: At any time he may give his token to any other SubGenius Group in play that has none.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Robo "Bob"
text: On your turn, link for good to a SubGenius Place you control (counts as its action): nobody else may ever control it, and it has +5 against attempts to destroy it. One per player.

name: Rogue SubGenii
text: When they have no token, their controller may discard a Plot to give them one, once per turn.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: S.C.A.M
text: Right after a rival rolls any die: the roll is void and made again. Costs the action of one of your Personalities.
playRequirement: Needs an action from a Personality group to play.

name: S.L.A.K.
text: Gets an Action token at each rival's token placement if it has none.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: S.P.U.T.U.M.
text: Triple Power in any attack on a Personality.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Sacred Jests
text: At any time: a rival picks one of their Plots at random and must play it at once or discard it; a Goal picked is shown instead.

name: Sacred Stencil
text: Unique. Against a rival's Attack to Destroy on any Group of yours, your defense may add +5 (in standard play, against Instant attacks too).
uniqueness: Unique Artifact

name: Saucer Landing Strip
text: When its controller holds no Plots, its token may be traded at any time for two Plots.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Schizm
text: With any attack on a Group controlled by one of your rivals: +10, even against a Group otherwise immune, uncontrollable or undestroyable. If the attack succeeds, the target and all its puppets become uncontrolled instead (with no uncontrolled area: the target is discarded and its puppets go to their owners' hands).

name: Science Cannot Remove the Terror of the Gods!
text: Goal: control Church Groups and have destroyed Science or Church Groups in one of these pairs: 5 and 2, 4 and 3, 3 and 4, 2 and 5, 1 and 6. Cannot be combined with another Goal.

name: Secret FisTemple
text: Can control only Personalities; each Personality it controls is SubGenius. May pass its token to its master or a puppet, if that Group is SubGenius by its own card. Always has its master's alignments.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Shordurpersav
text: Right after you roll: roll again. Costs an Illuminati action or two SubGenius actions.
playRequirement: Costs an Illuminati action or two SubGenius group actions.

name: Slackfusion
text: At any time: for the rest of the turn Illuminati tokens may be given and traded in deals, between Illuminati only.

name: Smite Them All!
text: Outside an attack, if you hold two or more Groups: each rival puts one card from the uncontrolled area at the bottom of the Group deck, then you put two. In standard play, each puts cards from hand at the bottom of their own deck.

name: Speakers in Tongues
text: +3 on any attempt to control a Church Group.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: St. Janor Hypercleats
text: In attacks he makes or aids, a roll of 11 does not fail automatically, but a natural 2 counts as 12 and his Illuminati loses a token if it has one. He may attack, or help attack, Secret Groups whatever their alignments.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Stark Fist of Removal
text: On your turn, pay every token on your Illuminati (at least one): a rival's Illuminati loses all of its tokens. Your turn then ends.
playRequirement: Requires spending all your Illuminati's tokens, and ends your turn.

name: SubGenius FisTemples
text: Every Group it controls gets +5 Resistance.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Sultan of Slack
text: At any time except while a victory is being contested: until your next turn, nobody wins by their Illuminati's Special Goal unless their Illuminati holds at least as many tokens as yours. Once per game.

name: Tape Runs Out...
text: Right after any Plot is played: cancel it and discard both. Costs an Illuminati action or three other Plot discards.

name: The 13th Apostle
text: Illuminati action, at any time: an Action token for any one Personality in play, or for several with 5 total Power or less. Not for Groups holding a token or barred from tokens.

name: The Anti"Bob"
text: Goal: control at least 6 SubGenius Groups and have destroyed at least 2 of your rivals' SubGenius or Weird Groups. Expose it yourself for one extra Illuminati token (once per game); it can then never be hidden or leave your hand.

name: The Hour of Slack
text: When a rival declares an attack on a Group in your Power Structure, draw a Plot.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: The Prescriptures
text: Unique. Once on each of your turns, spend an Illuminati action or the actions of all your Personalities (at least one): look at the top three cards of any two decks in the game, or at a rival's Plots.
uniqueness: Unique Artifact

name: The Saint of Sales
text: On your turn, with an Illuminati action or SubGenius actions of 4 total Power: take one Resource from the uncontrolled area or your hand into play without a roll.
playRequirement: Needs a SubGenius or Illuminati action

name: The True Pipe
text: Unique. Your Illuminati gets +2 Power and +2 Global Power; does not stack with other Resources that raise your Illuminati's Power.
uniqueness: Unique Artifact

name: The World Ends Tomorrow and You May Die!
text: With an attack on a Group in the uncontrolled area (in standard play, a Group in hand): the attacker spends its token and must share an alignment with the target or be Media; the attack succeeds at once. Your turn then ends.

name: They May Be Pink. . .
text: When a Straight Group is attacked: all your Weird and SubGenius Groups may help defend it.

name: Three-Fisted Tales of "Bob"
text: Unique. Link to a SubGenius Place: +2 Power and Global Power equal to its new Power.
uniqueness: Unique Artifact

name: Time Control
text: On your turn: your Illuminati makes one direct attack at its normal Power without spending a token. You may spend no Illuminati tokens this turn, before or after, except to buy Plots.

name: www.subgenius.com
text: At the start of each of your turns you may draw an extra Group into the uncontrolled area. In standard play, spend its action at any time to draw a Group card.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: X-Day
text: At any time: discard all your Plots and draw as many new ones, four at most. Once per turn.

name: Xists
text: Cannot really be controlled. When destroyed they go to the uncontrolled area (to the destroyer's hand in standard play) and never count as destroyed for other cards.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: Yacatisma
text: Outside an attack, with a SubGenius action: two random hidden Plots of one rival are discarded.

name: Yetis
text: May hang on any open side of its master, arrow or not; any Group with an open side may attack to control it.
uniqueness: One copy in play at a time (base rule)

name: You'd Pay to Know What You Really Think!
text: Outside an attack: send one of your Groups with no puppets (not your Illuminati) to the uncontrolled area (discard it in standard play) and put the top Group card in its place with its tokens. A Resource goes to your Resources; a Group that cannot legally hang there is discarded and you draw a Plot.
